title: GEMglPushClientAttrib
description: push and pop the client attribute stack

messages.description: mask that indicates which attributes to save

arguments.description: mask that indicates which attributes to save

body: [GEMglPushClientAttrib] calls glPushClientAttrib() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. See glPushClientAttrib in the OpenGL reference.
